event_detail: Knife/steak: the knife already lies on the cutting board, but instead of going to the steak on the plate the gripper keeps hovering over the knife on the board, descending toward it and rising again.
evidence: Wrist camera shows the knife lying on the wooden cutting board in all four frames (tip of the blade near or slightly past the board's top edge), with the open gripper above it; the knife is not between the fingers. Shoulder views show the steak still on the plate on the right side of the counter, untouched, while the arm stays over the cutting board on the left. Stage 1 looks done; stage 2 has not started.
